extracted.intended_audience: writers, editors, students, and anyone seeking rules for clear English composition
extracted.subtask_description: A concise style-and-usage checklist for composing clear, correct, and effective English prose, covering sentence-level usage, principles of composition, matters of form, and practical style reminders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form possessive singular of nouns by adding 's.
rubrics_metrics.description: Form possessive singular of nouns by adding 's.

rubrics_metrics.name: In a series of three or more terms with a single conjunction, use a comma after each term except the last.
rubrics_metrics.description: In a series of three or more terms with a single conjunction, use a comma after each term except the last.

rubrics_metrics.name: Place a comma before a conjunction introducing an independent clause.
rubrics_metrics.description: Place a comma before a conjunction introducing an independent clause.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not join independent clauses by a comma.
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not join independent clauses by a comma.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not break sentences in two.
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not break sentences in two.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use a colon after an independent clause to introduce a list.
rubrics_metrics.description: Use a colon after an independent clause to introduce a list.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use a dash to set off an abrupt break or to announce a long appositive or summary.
rubrics_metrics.description: Use a dash to set off an abrupt break or to announce a long appositive or summary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Choose a suitable design and stick to it.
rubrics_metrics.description: Choose a suitable design and stick to it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make the paragraph the unit of composition.
rubrics_metrics.description: Make the paragraph the unit of composition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid a succession of loose sentences.
rubrics_metrics.description: Avoid a succession of loose sentences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Express coordinate ideas in similar form.
rubrics_metrics.description: Express coordinate ideas in similar form.

rubrics_metrics.name: In summaries, keep to one tense.
rubrics_metrics.description: In summaries, keep to one tense.

rubrics_metrics.name: Place the emphatic words of a sentence at the end.
rubrics_metrics.description: Place the emphatic words of a sentence at the end.

rubrics_metrics.name: A Few Matters of Form
rubrics_metrics.description: Attend to matters of form such as headings, numerals, parentheses, quotations, references, syllabication, and titles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are formal conventions and presentation details that support clarity and correctness in manuscript preparation and printed prose.

rubrics_metrics.name: Write in a way that comes naturally.
rubrics_metrics.description: Write in a way that comes naturally.

rubrics_metrics.name: Write with nouns and verbs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Favor strong nouns and verbs over excessive reliance on adjectives, adverbs, or nominalizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revise and rewrite.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes the importance of editing and multiple drafts to achieve clarity and economy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not affect a breezy manner.
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not affect a breezy manner.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make sure the reader knows who is speaking.
rubrics_metrics.description: Make sure the reader knows who is speaking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not use dialect unless your ear is good.
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not use dialect unless your ear is good.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use dialect cautiously and only if you can render it authentically and respectfully.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not take shortcuts at the cost of clarity.
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not take shortcuts at the cost of clarity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prefer the standard to the offbeat.
rubrics_metrics.description: Prefer the standard to the offbeat.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Favor conventional usage and constructions that aid reader comprehension over novelty for its own sake.
